'''Wookiee Trading Co.''' was a trade company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Employees could be found, among other places, in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunting camp near the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]]. These [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] bought all kinds of things that [[adventurer]]s acquired on their journeys through the Kashyyykian jungles.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' players can sell almost all items they loot from killed enemies for small amounts of credits to [[:w:c:swg:Junk Dealer|Junk Dealer]] [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|NPCs]]. On the planet Kashyyyk these NPCs are Wookiees, called "a Wookiee Trading Co. Employee".
